'''Sunbleak Cave''' is a dungeon found in the middle of [[Sunbleak Island]].

The cave contains some rocks which can be [[mining|mined]] and a few [[Giant bat|giant bats]] and [[Spider|spiders]].

A [[Skeleton|skeleton]] is in an inaccessible room behind a barred door.
{{Map|x=2209|y=2330|mtype=pin|2218,2329|align=left|icon=redPin|caption=The [[Cave entrance (Sunbleak Cave)|entrance]] to the cave.}}
